Standard: Non-safety-critical modifications, failures of non-safety-critical equipment, and test instrumentation do not result in the loss or degradation of SCFs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Review design artifacts, SCFTA, and FMECA to identify failures with non-safety-critical equipment that may impact SCFs.
(2) Review test instrumentation documentation, system design, and interface specifications to ensure test instrumentation does not adversely affect the air vehicle. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct FMET and regression tests to verify failures produce expected behaviors and non-safety-critical failures do not adversely impact SCFs.
  (2) Ground test: Perform air vehicle flight regression testing of the modification to verify the performance of SCFs. Flight test results demonstrate non-SCFs and test instrumentation do not impact performance of SCFs. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (3) Flight test: Perform air vehicle flight regression testing to verify the performance of SCFs. Flight test results demonstrate non-SCFs, and any test instrumentation do not impact performance of SCFs.
